name: Padon
title: Temple Servant Who Returned from Exile
summary: Padon was the ancestor of a family of Nethinim (temple servants) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile. His descendants are mentioned among those who returned with Zerubbabel to rebuild the temple and restore worship in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Recorded Among the Temple Servants in the Book of Ezra
keyEvents.description: Padon's descendants are listed among the Nethinim (temple servants) who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Recorded Among the Temple Servants in the Book of Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Padon's descendants are again mentioned in Nehemiah's parallel list of those who returned from the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: The Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Padon's family was part of the large group that returned to Judah under Zerubbabel's leadership to rebuild the temple and restore worship.

keyEvents.title: The Role of the Temple Servants in the Rebuilding
keyEvents.description: As Nethinim, Padon's descendants had an important serving function at the temple, contributing to the restoration of religious practice in Jerusalem after the exile.
